description.text: High-Class Deck Gengar VMAX, a 60-card deck released on 28 May 2021 with Inteleon VMAX's, built from Single Strike cards around two Gengar V and two Gengar VMAX. Houndoom puts a Single Strike Energy from the deck onto a Single Strike Pokémon to power Gengar VMAX up quickly, and the deck brought the new Supporter Adventurer's Discovery, which finds up to three Pokémon V. Every one of its 60 cards is holo, and a special-art version of its Pokémon VMAX could rarely be found in place of the regular one. It came with a coin, damage counters and markers and a player's guide, and the two High-Class Decks were also sold together in a Double BOX with Tyranitar V and Empoleon V promos.
